title: Binary Search Trace — English
purpose: English baseline for semantic localization parity, number/code preservation, caption layout, speech alignment, and locale-safe rendering.

objectives.statement: Explain why sorted order enables binary search.
Preserve the exact three-step trace and result across locales.

claims.statement: Binary search depends on sorted order to eliminate one side after a comparison.
The trace compares 16, 56, and 23, then returns index 5.

scenes.title: Why sorted order matters
scenes.narration: Binary search works because the list is sorted. Compare the target with the midpoint, then discard the side that cannot contain it.
scenes.visualIntent: A sorted array uses locale-independent numerals and labeled low, mid, and high markers.
scenes.captionText: Sorted order lets us safely discard one side.
scenes.accessibilityDescription: A sorted array shows an inclusive candidate interval and one midpoint.

scenes.title: Find 23
scenes.narration: First compare 16. The target is larger. Next compare 56. The target is smaller. Finally compare 23 and return index 5.
scenes.visualIntent: Three trace rows preserve values, indices, and code tokens exactly across locales.
scenes.accessibilityDescription: Three rows state the compared value, relation to the target, and interval update.

scenes.title: Halve the candidates
scenes.narration: Keep the sorted-order invariant, compare the midpoint, and halve the candidates. The running time is O log n.
scenes.visualIntent: A short concept thread ends with O(log n) as an unchanged mathematical token.
scenes.captionText: Sorted list • midpoint • half remains • O(log n)
scenes.accessibilityDescription: A four-step recap lists the invariant, midpoint comparison, reduced interval, and complexity.

qualityAssertions.description: Numbers, code tokens, and complexity stay exact.
All required glyphs render without missing-glyph boxes.
The localized version preserves the two objectives and exact trace meaning.
Both targets render deterministically with locale-safe line breaks.

provenance.notes: English baseline authored locally and paired by assertion sequence with Spanish and Hindi variants.
